name: Addon for Post Meta Translation using DeepL
author: badasswp

sections.description:
As you may have already noticed, the DeepL for WordPress: translation plugin only translates the post title, content and excerpt. This means that vital post meta data is left out of most translations for users.

This plugin extends the functionality of the DeepL for WordPress: translation plugin by enabling you to translate post meta data easily during translations. It integrates nicely with the DeepL for WordPress & DeepL for WordPress pro plugin and is useful for translating post meta for popular plugins like WooCommerce, Yoast SEO and so on.

✔️ Features

Our plugin comes with everything you need for translating post meta when using DeepL.

✔️ Integrates nicely with the DeepL for WordPress & DeepL for WordPress pro plugins.
✔️ Support for major WordPress plugins such as WooCommerce, Yoast SEO and so on.
✔️ Custom Filters to help user modify post meta.
✔️ Available in multiple languages such as Arabic, Chinese, Hebrew, Hindi, Russian, German, Italian, Croatian, Spanish & French languages.
✔️ Backward compatible, works with most WP versions.

✨ Getting Started

  1. Make sure you already have DeepL for WordPress: translation plugin installed and activated.
  2. Create a post or article and ensure it has post meta (you can use custom fields to do this).
  3. Proceed to translate your post or article using DeepL for WordPress: translation plugin.
  4. Observe that your post meta is also translated after the translation is completed by DeepL.

You can get a taste of how this plugin works, by using the demo link.

🔌🎨 Plug and Play or Customize

The Addon for Post Meta Translation using DeepL plugin is built to work right out of the box. Simply install, activate and start using.

Want to add your personal touch? All of our documentation can be found here. You can override the plugin’s behaviour with custom logic of your own using hooks.

Contribute

If you’d like to contribute to the development of this plugin, you can find it on GitHub.
sections.installation:
1. Go to ‘Plugins > Add New’ on your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Search for ‘Addon for Post Meta Translation using DeepL’ plugin from the official WordPress plugin repository.
  3. Click ‘Install Now’ and then ‘Activate’.
  4. That’s it! You’re all set to start translating your post meta.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial plugin release.
  • Integrates nicely with WooCommerce, Yoast SEO, EasyAccordion and so on.
  • Feat: Add Post meta translation across all post meta values of a translated post.
  • Feat: Add Post meta translation for Easy Accordion content.
  • Feat: Custom filter – addon_for_post_meta_translation_using_deepl_excluded_meta_keys.
  • Test: Update unit tests.
  • Update README docs.
  • Tested up to WP 6.8.2.
